ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Cracked Lands (kept art, old path)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Textures-only stub left at the old src/RimMandrake/FloodedCanyon path by CRACKEDLANDS_FULL_RENAME_1 (FloodedCanyon -> CrackedLands). It holds the owner-kept Cracked Lands pictures (and the folders they share) whose old slot can only be retired on the owner's typed words (art ledger, ART_VERSION_WRANGLING_1). It ships composed inside RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes as entry CrackedLandsKeptArt; texPaths are relative to Textures/, so the defs in src/RimMandrake/CrackedLands find them unchanged. Once he releases them: move them with src/RimMandrake/Utils/art/move_mod_textures.py, then delete this folder and its compose entry.
